name: TeamStarWolf - HTB Technique Frequency
description: Curated practitioner view, not an official MITRE mapping. Derived from Claude's supplied analysis of the user's own HTB writeups: derived technique metadata only, not reproduced content. The reported sample covers all 131 analyzed HTB machines and contains 131 distinct techniques. Sources: the supplied htb-technique-frequency-data.json aggregate and data/attack/technique_profiles.jsonl for ID and tactic validation. Scores normalize machine counts to the most frequent technique (105 machines), not to the sample size; 100 does not mean 100% of machines. This reflects HTB's teaching bias, not real-world enterprise prevalence. Counts were imported from the supplied aggregate, not independently re-audited against machine-level writeups.

metadata.name: source
metadata.value: htb-technique-frequency-data.json (supplied aggregate; private source retained outside this repository)

metadata.name: score_meaning
metadata.value: Relative frequency within the supplied HTB aggregate, normalized to the maximum count; not percentage of machines, severity, enterprise prevalence, confidence, or control coverage.

metadata.name: counting_policy
metadata.value: Source count = number of machines demonstrating each listed technique. Parent and subtechnique counts are preserved as separate supplied observations, not rolled up or summed. Techniques may overlap within a machine; scores and counts are not additive.

metadata.name: tactic_policy
metadata.value: Each selected technique is shown under all tactics in data/attack/technique_profiles.jsonl with the same count and score. This is display expansion, not evidence that the behavior occurred in every tactic. Do not sum repeated tactic rows.

metadata.name: limitations
metadata.value: HTB's teaching bias and the user's selected collection limit generalization. Missing techniques are unscored, not measured zeroes. The aggregate provides no per-machine attribution, so layer validation checks identifiers and arithmetic, not the underlying writeup analysis.

metadata.value: Codex Task 3 per Claude Code handoff (full 131-machine dataset update)
